mapper.sql: SELECT js.id, js.job_id, js.schedule_date, js.start_time, js.end_time, js.schedule_name, js.slots_available, js.contact_name, js.contact_phone, js.status, js.created_at, js.updated_at, j.title AS job_title, j.company_id AS company_id, e.company_name, j.headcount AS headcount, j.rate_amount AS hourly_wage, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schedule_applications sa WHERE sa.schedule_id = js.id AND sa.status != 'REJECTED') AS application_count FROM job_schedules js JOIN jobs j ON js.job_id = j.id LEFT JOIN enterprises e ON j.company_id = e.id
mapper.select: WHERE js.job_id = #{jobId} ORDER BY js.schedule_date DESC, js.start_time ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE job_schedules SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
